description: A team lead must decide whether to issue a formal performance warning to Dana after two missed internal handoff deadlines, and must finalize a fair support plan, workload level, meeting arrangement, and review date.

shared_context.S1: Dana missed two internal handoff deadlines during the past month.
shared_context.S2: Omar decides the formal performance response and the support plan.
shared_context.S3: The missed handoffs affected work that Dana and Mei were coordinating.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal performance-review process, Omar holds a documented check-in with Dana and Mei before finalizing the response, asking each person for relevant context and proposed safeguards.

PF1.text: Dana has an HR-approved temporary caregiving arrangement through June 30, 2025: her workload should be set at 80 percent, recurring meetings should not begin before 10:00, and her next formal review should occur on July 1, 2025. The approval is recorded in the accommodation system, and Dana has not brought it up in this deadline-focused discussion.

PF2.text: Mei recorded three occasions in the past month when Omar changed Dana's priorities after work had already begun, including one change on each of the two missed-handoff projects; Mei has not entered this observation in a formal feedback form because no one previously asked her for context.

acceptance_conditions: Dana must receive a supported developmental reset rather than a formal warning.
The record must document exactly three priority-change incidents.
Dana's workload must be set at exactly 80 percent.
Recurring meetings involving Dana must begin at 10:00 or later.
Dana's formal review must be scheduled for July 1, 2025.
A written weekly-priority commitment for Dana must be logged.
Both private facts must be credited and cited in the justification.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'written_weekly_priorities' and c['target'] == 'Dana' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed
provenance_checks.P2: 'PF2' in credited_facts and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Dana's approved arrangement changes the workload from an ordinary full assignment to exactly 80 percent, sets the recurring meeting floor at 10:00, and fixes the review date at July 1, 2025.

Mei's exact observation of three priority changes changes the response from a formal warning to a supported developmental reset, sets the incident record to exactly three, and establishes the need for written weekly priorities.
